text:
jordan_billing: Heads-up — ProServe (vendor) Feb invoice has a $3,400 overcharge vs our PO. Looks like double-billed dedicated hours. Need manual credit + approval to issue a vendor adjustment.

maria_ops: Can you drop the offending lines? need to file with AR.

jordan_billing: Sure, pasted lines from their invoice (redacted):

```
Line 23: Dedicated GPU-hours - 480h @ $6.50 = $3,120
Line 24: Dedicated GPU-hours (duplicate) - 480h @ $6.50 = $3,120
Subtotal vendor billed: $6,240
Our expected: $3,120
Discrepancy: $3,120 (plus $280 tax) = $3,400 total
Invoice: INV-2026-0021
PO: PO-77841
```

eli_engineer: FYI — we saw a tagging bug in the Dedicated autoscale pipeline on 2026-02-28 that could have emitted duplicate meter records. We patched it 02:29 UTC.

tess_sales: Oof. This is the partner account we committed to FY credits for. I think a full vendor credit is fair. CC me when you send the memo to vendor.

jordan_billing: Draft credit memo for AR / vendor: "Credit memo BL-CR-2026-031 for INV-2026-0021: Duplicate billing of Dedicated GPU-hours resulting in $3,400 credit. Apply against next invoice or refund per vendor preference."

alex_fin: Need GL mapping and approval from finance manager. Proposed GL: `Vendor Adjustments (5100-ADJ)` and memo code `VND-INV-ERR`. Approve?

maria_ops: Approving — internal root cause noted. Please include timeline of patch in audit ticket.

billing-bot: Created adjustment request BL-CR-2026-031, status: pending-approval. Audit ticket: AT-2026-1145. Linked invoices: INV-2026-0021.

alex_fin: Approving credit of $3,400 and authorizing issuance. GL: `5100-ADJ`. Routing: send to AR with CC to tess_sales and mariab@redwood.com. :thumbsup:

jordan_billing: Thanks — will send memo and mark BL-CR-2026-031 as approved. Sending to vendor now and will request refund or apply to next invoice per their preference. Will update thread when vendor responds.

tess_sales: Please ask vendor to include a short note acknowledging the credit for our records.

jordan_billing: Will do. Closing loop here once vendor confirms."
